description: Defines classes and functions for high-precision time management in QUIC, including QuicTime, QuicTimeDelta, and QuicWallTime, with support for durations, timestamps, and conversions.

classes.name: QuicTimeDelta
classes.description: Represents a duration of time in microseconds, with methods for creation, conversion, and comparison.

classes.name: QuicTime
classes.description: Represents a high-precision timestamp, with support for zero, infinite, and arithmetic operations.

classes.name: QuicWallTime
classes.description: Represents a UNIX timestamp with methods for conversion and comparison.

methods.name: QuicTimeDelta::Zero
methods.description: Returns a QuicTimeDelta representing zero duration.

methods.name: QuicTimeDelta::Infinite
methods.description: Returns a QuicTimeDelta representing an infinite duration.

methods.name: QuicTime::Zero
methods.description: Returns a QuicTime representing zero time.

methods.name: QuicTime::Infinite
methods.description: Returns a QuicTime representing an infinite timestamp.

methods.name: QuicWallTime::FromUNIXSeconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicWallTime from UNIX seconds.

methods.name: QuicWallTime::FromUNIXMicroseconds
methods.description: Creates a QuicWallTime from microseconds since UNIX epoch.
